name: Gated DeltaNet · GDN
tagline: Shrink the memory with one gate per head, then correct it.
description: A scalar, input-dependent forget gate per head (the Mamba2 form) decays the state before a delta-rule correction. Gate parameters follow the FLA layer's initialization. The training kernel broadcasts the head gate through FLA's chunked KDA kernel, which is mathematically identical.
paperTitle: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
mechanism: S ← α(I − βkkᵀ)S + βkvᵀ with one α per head and token
log α = −exp(A_log)·softplus(W_a x + dt_bias); conv + SiLU, L2 q/k, sigmoid β
Output RMSNorm × gain × SiLU gate; FLA chunk kernels
limitations: Pure GDN, without the hybrid attention layers of the GDN-H1/H2 or Qwen3-Next models. On Hopper with Triton 3.5 the dedicated GDN kernel is guarded off (FLA #640), so the equivalent KDA kernel with a broadcast gate is used.
